tool_analysis: Step Analysis: Recorded session logs show an authenticated admin session on Magento 1.9.3.8 and direct interactions with the Credit Memos grid: closed an 'Incoming Message' overlay, filled filters, applied Search, used Export (CSV), selected a row, applied a mass-action 'PDF Credit Memos', and opened a credit memo View page. Task Definition: Create a reusable tool that navigates to the credit memo grid, optionally applies filters (credit memo #, order #, bill-to, refunded range), triggers export, performs a mass-action, and opens a credit memo View. Action Plan: 1) Navigate to grid URL; 2) close overlay if present; 3) set zero or more filters (creditmemo_number, order_increment_id, bill_to_name, refunded_from, refunded_to); 4) click Search; 5) capture filtered grid; 6) optionally select export format and trigger Export; 7) select first row checkbox; 8) optionally select mass-action option and Submit; 9) optionally open View link for a specified credit memo id; 10) extract View page details. Variable Identification: base_admin_url (required), grid_id (optional for scoping), creditmemo_number, order_increment_id, bill_to_name, refunded_from, refunded_to, export_format (CSV/Excel/XML), massaction_option (e.g. 'PDF Credit Memos'), view_creditmemo_id. Step Optimization: - Navigation uses direct URL to grid to avoid extra clicks. - Overlay close uses visible text 'close' with recorded elementHash fallback. - Filters use header-text XPaths scoped by grid id when provided to maximize stability. - Export and mass-action use select+button interactions rather than trying to construct export URLs (form_key is session-specific). - Where stable elementHashes were recorded they are included as fallbacks, but primary selectors target semantic XPaths/CSS. Assumptions & Limitations: - Tool assumes the browser context is already authenticated (session cookie present). - Some admin installations may change header text/localization; grid_id helps scope selectors. - form_key and other CSRF tokens are handled by the browser session; this tool does not perform login. - The tool is deterministic (no branching) but steps that depend on optional inputs are executed; if inputs are empty they will be attempted but have no effect (caller should provide only the filters/actions desired).
name: magento_admin_creditmemo_tool
description: Locate and operate on Magento admin Credit Memos (filters, search, export, mass-action, open View). Assumes an authenticated admin session is already available in the browser context. Uses grid-scoped selectors and fallbacks recorded during a session on dockerized-magento.local.

steps.description: Navigate to the Credit Memos grid page.
Wait for the grid and any overlays to render.
Close the incoming-message overlay if present (uses visible 'close' link). Fallback: recorded elementHash.
Allow overlay to close and grid to re-render.
Set Credit Memo # filter when provided. Scoped to grid id if {grid_id} provided, otherwise locate by header text.
Set Order # filter when provided.
Set Bill to Name filter when provided.
Set Refunded 'From' filter when provided (first input in Refunded header cell).
Set Refunded 'To' filter when provided (second input in Refunded header cell).
Click the Search button to apply filters. Fallback elementHash recorded.
Wait for the filtered grid results to load.

steps.goal: Capture grid results after filtering (rows, view links, and available controls).

steps.description: If {export_format} provided: select the export format in the grid export control (visible text: CSV/Excel/XML). Uses recorded export select as fallback.
If {export_format} provided: click the Export button to trigger export. Uses recorded elementHash as fallback.
Allow export to start / download to trigger.
Select the first visible row checkbox (used before mass-action). Fallback to recorded elementHash for the first-row checkbox.
If {massaction_option} provided: select the mass-action option (e.g. 'PDF Credit Memos').
If massaction selected: click the massaction Submit button to apply it.
Wait for mass-action processing to complete (PDF generation / download may start).
If {view_creditmemo_id} provided: open the View page for that credit memo id using the href fragment. Fallback: click the first View link if id omitted.
Wait for the credit memo View page to load.

steps.goal: Extract key details from the credit memo View page (order number, billing/shipping, totals) and return as 'creditmemo_view'.

input_schema.name: base_admin_url
input_schema.description: Base admin URL including index.php/admin path, e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin'

input_schema.name: grid_id
input_schema.description: HTML id of the credit memo grid container (used to scope selectors). Observed value: 'sales_creditmemo_grid'. Leave empty to use header-text selectors.

input_schema.name: creditmemo_number
input_schema.description: Filter value for Credit Memo # (increment id), e.g. '100000008'.

input_schema.name: order_increment_id
input_schema.description: Filter value for Order # (increment id), e.g. '000000299'.

input_schema.name: bill_to_name
input_schema.description: Filter value for Bill to Name, e.g. 'Sarah Miller'.

input_schema.name: refunded_from
input_schema.description: Filter for Refunded 'From' value (numeric or currency without symbol), e.g. '20'.

input_schema.name: refunded_to
input_schema.description: Filter for Refunded 'To' value (numeric or currency without symbol), e.g. '30'.

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to choose from grid export controls. Use 'CSV', 'Excel' or 'XML'. Default behavior: no export if omitted.

input_schema.name: massaction_option
input_schema.description: Visible label of the mass-action option to apply (example: 'PDF Credit Memos'). If omitted the mass-action step is skipped.

input_schema.name: view_creditmemo_id
input_schema.description: Credit memo numeric id to open the View page (for example '8'). If omitted the View step is skipped.
